players.product: PCIe Gen6 switches and retimers, timing, Ethernet PHYs and optical-module connectivity

quarterly_data.signal: Q1 FY2027 net sales were $1.485 billion, up 38% year-over-year and 13.2% sequentially; non-GAAP gross margin was 63.8%, operating margin 35.1% and EPS $0.76. Data center was 17.1% of sales and grew 97.8% year-over-year.
quarterly_data.figure: $1.485B revenue (+38% YoY, +13.2% QoQ); data center 17.1% of sales, +97.8% YoY

quarterly_data.signal: Total data-center revenue is expected to grow about 69% from approximately $591 million in calendar 2025 to about $1 billion in calendar 2026. The exposure spans PCIe Gen6 switches and retimers, storage and NVMe controllers, timing and synchronization, Ethernet switches and PHYs, optical modules, security and memory.

Microchip had 14 PCIe Gen6 design wins as of the call: 12 switch programs and two retimer programs spanning both scale-up and scale-out at hyperscaler and enterprise customers. Gen6 entered production at the end of June, but none of the 14 wins was yet shipping in volume; management expects significant data-center growth in 2027 and thereafter.
quarterly_data.figure: 14 PCIe Gen6 wins (12 switch, 2 retimer); production began end-June; volume ramps ahead

quarterly_data.signal: June-quarter book-to-bill was well above 1, backlog entered September higher than it entered June, and bookings were the strongest in about four years. Distribution sell-through rose 17% sequentially as channel inventory fell to 25 days.
quarterly_data.figure: book-to-bill well above 1; strongest bookings in ~4 years; sell-through +17% QoQ

quarterly_data.signal: For Q2 FY2027, Microchip expects net sales to increase 8% sequentially, plus or minus 1%; at the midpoint, that would be up 40.6% year over year. Non-GAAP gross margin is expected at 66%-67%, operating margin at 38.5%-39.5% and diluted EPS at $0.91-$0.95.
quarterly_data.figure: Q2 revenue +8% QoQ +/-1% (+40.6% YoY at midpoint); GM 66%-67%; operating margin 38.5%-39.5%; EPS $0.91-$0.95

quarterly_data.signal: Lead times are stretching beyond the prior four-to-eight-week range as constraints spread across substrates, foundry nodes, subcontracted assembly and test. Expedite requests increased sharply and many orders placed inside lead time could not be supported; management said AI demand is crowding out advanced packaging and substrate capacity.
quarterly_data.figure: foundry, substrate, advanced-packaging and OSAT constraints; unsupported expedite demand

The portfolio includes power management, mixed-signal devices, microcontrollers, timing, security and memory.

The portfolio includes power management, mixed-signal devices, microcontrollers, timing, security and memory.

quarterly_data.signal: Microchip's data-center catalog revenue outside its dedicated Data Center Solutions unit is expected to grow from approximately $288 million in 2025 to about $500 million in 2026. Management identified grid-to-rack and in-rack power as one of five core applications, supplied by power-management ICs, converters, mixed-signal devices and controllers.

Management said hundreds of catalog design wins are ramping across the data-center rack, including power-management and bus-conversion sockets. Unlike the 14 identified Gen6 programs, these wins are distributed across power-supply makers, card stuffers and module manufacturers rather than contracted directly with hyperscalers.
quarterly_data.figure: hundreds of catalog design wins across rack power and control
